Pomegranate Milk Shake
By: miansari66
Published: Thursday, November 4, 2010 - 11:01pm

Ingredients




1 inch Pomegranate 4- 5 dia one number
2 glass Ice Chilled Milk one

Preparation

1 Remove seeds from fruit. 2 Take a double layered muslin cloth (Malmal Cloth) , put seed on it and make a pouch. 3 Now pressed this pouch against the surface of a large tray. Redish colored juice will appear in the try. 4 Generally one pomegranate gives one glass of juice. 5 Mix this juice with chilled milk. No need to add sugar. 6 You will enjoy the color and taste of this milk shake. 7 This Shake is a rich source of vitamin A , C and Calcium , Magnesium Phosphorus and Potassium and Iron

About


 Here I wants to share my recipe of pomegranate milk shake.  Pomegranate juice/nector can be used pure, or you can add 1 teaspoon of honey.
